android.desc:
Sift is a daily news briefing app that helps you understand world news — not just read headlines. Get a focused news digest of the most important global stories, explained clearly. Instead of hundreds of updates, Sift gives you a small number of essential stories each day — with context, meaning, and what could happen next.

Understand the news, not just read it
Each story helps you quickly understand what’s going on:
• why it matters to you
• what’s happening behind the scenes
• what could happen next
So you don’t just stay updated — you actually understand the world better.

What Sift does
Sift filters hundreds of headlines to bring you only a few important stories each day.
Instead of endless feeds, you get:
• a daily news briefing and audio summary
• important world news and global events
• a daily insight to think differently — not just about the news
• simple summaries across technology, business, science, and geopolitics
• a calm, focused reading experience

Built for clarity, not overload
• No endless news feed
• No repeated stories
• No overwhelming volume
Just a clean, minimal news app designed for focus.

Why people use Sift
• Stay informed without spending hours
• Get a quick overview of important news
• Understand global events quickly
• Avoid distractions and unnecessary headlines
• Read in a calm, minimal interface

A different kind of news app
Unlike traditional news apps that prioritize speed and volume, Sift focuses on clarity and relevance.
You don’t need to read everything — just what matters.

Listen to the news

Prefer listening instead of reading? Sift lets you listen to your daily news briefing as an audio summary. Whether you're commuting, walking, or multitasking, you can stay informed with concise audio news that explains the stories that matter.

Simple, fast, and focused
• Lightweight and fast
• Easy to use
• Designed for distraction-free reading

If you want a simple daily news app that helps you stay informed without overwhelm, Sift is built for you.
